stories.title: Create blog post metadata config with Zod schema validation
stories.description: Establish a centralized, type-safe blog post metadata system using Zod to validate frontmatter structure. This enables consistent metadata reuse across blog routes and supports future blog post creation at scale.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/src/lib/blog-metadata.ts with Zod schema for title, slug, publishedAt, readingTime, featured, author, excerpt, tags, and canonical fields
Create site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts data file containing 3+ complete blog post entries matching the schema
Verify schema validation passes: uv run vitest site/src/lib/blog-metadata.test.ts --grep 'validates.*frontmatter'
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/blog-metadata.ts (export const BlogPostSchema = z.object({...}))
File to create: site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts (export const BLOG_POSTS: z.infer<typeof BlogPostSchema>[])
Test command: uv run vitest site/src/lib/blog-metadata.test.ts -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Add estimated reading time and table of contents to blog post template
stories.description: Enhance blog post UX by displaying estimated reading time in post metadata and rendering an interactive table of contents from markdown headings. Improves engagement metrics and content discoverability.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement calculateReadingTime(content: string): number function in site/src/lib/blog-utils.ts (assumes 200 words per minute)
Add <TableOfContents /> component to site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx that renders anchor links for h2 and h3 headings
Verify reading time calculation: uv run vitest site/src/lib/blog-utils.test.ts --grep 'calculateReadingTime' shows correct minute counts
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/TableOfContents.tsx (parse markdown headings, render sticky nav)
File to edit: site/src/lib/blog-utils.ts (add calculateReadingTime function)
Test command: uv run vitest site/src/lib/blog-utils.test.ts -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Add dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using next/og ImageResponse
stories.description: Generate unique, branded OG images for each blog post dynamically at request time using Next.js next/og. Improves social sharing click-through rates and brand visibility on social platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/src/app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx that generates 1200x630px images with blog title, author initials, and Pelangi branding
Image generation must handle missing or malformed slug gracefully with fallback hostel branding image
Verify OG image returns 200: curl -I 'http://localhost:3000/blog/test-post/opengraph-image' shows Content-Type: image/png
technicalNotes: File to edit: next.config.ts (add unsafeAllowedExternalUrls if using external font/image URLs)
Test command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/blog-og-image.spec.ts
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Create llms.txt file for AI crawler content guidance and discoverability
stories.description: Add a machine-readable llms.txt file at the root that guides AI crawlers and large language models on hostel information, travel guides, and job seeker resources. Improves visibility in Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT web search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/public/llms.txt with sections: Hostel Overview, Rooms & Amenities, Travel Guides (JB & Singapore), Job Seeker Resources, Visa & Border Info, and Blog Feed with brief content anchors
Include clear URLs and brief descriptions for each major content section (not boilerplate, actual URLs from sitemap.ts)
Verify file accessibility and format: curl 'http://localhost:3000/llms.txt' returns 200 with Content-Type: text/plain and valid UTF-8
technicalNotes: File to create: site/public/llms.txt (text file with content sections for AI crawler guidance, ~100 lines)
File to reference: site/src/lib/sitemap.ts (ensure URLs match actual routes)
Test command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/llms-txt-availability.spec.ts
